subject: ISV marketplace listing & co-sell: entitlement / metering handoff
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara@novaai.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: ISV listing + co-sell / metering sync

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking time to chat yesterday. As discussed, Nova AI is ready to get listed on AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces and we'd like Redwood to be a listed partner for co-sell engagement. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm metering integration options (usage events or metered SKUs).
- Outline entitlement mapping (Redwood customers -> Nova product SKUs).
- Timeline for listing & co-sell enablement (we're targeting Q3 launch).

I've attached a short SOW and a first-draft metering spreadsheet for your review. Can you put me in touch with the marketplace / co-sell lead on your side who owns metering and entitlements?

Attachments: nova_marketplace_sow.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,
Sara Chen
Head of Partnerships | Nova AI
{sara@novaai.com}
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Chen <sara@novaai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:03:21 -0400
Subject: Re: ISV listing + co-sell / metering sync

Sara —

Appreciate the note and the SOW. Welcome — excited about Nova's product. Looping in Marissa (partner/onboarding) and Karthik (cloud listings & metering) so they can scope the work. Quick answers up front: 

- Metering: we support both metered SKUs (billing events forwarded) and usage reporting integrations (we can push daily usage events into marketplace metering APIs). Karthik, correct me if I'm oversimplifying.
- Entitlement mapping: we typically map Redwood customer IDs to partner SKUs via a shared entitlement table; that's a standard step during onboarding.
- Timeline: typical cadence is 6-8 weeks for a single provider if we have metering spec and legal completed; for multi-cloud launches plan 8-12 weeks.

Action items: 
1) Marissa — please pull together our marketplace intake checklist and slot Nova for an intake call next week.
2) Karthik — review the attached metering sheet and send a short gap list (API schemas, event names, sample payload).
3) Sara — please confirm whether Nova prefers metered SKU or usage-event integration and share any vendor-specific constraints (e.g., retention, PII in payload).

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan after Marissa scopes.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: ISV listing + co-sell / metering sync (intake checklist + gaps)

Ben / Karthik —

Following up with a working checklist for the intake call and a few items I want us to collect from Nova before the call. See inline items below. I'll schedule a 30-minute intake on Monday 07/16.

Marketplace intake checklist (for Nova AI) — please confirm: 
- Marketplace contact + billing owner (required)
- Desired launch clouds: GCP + Azure (per Sara's note; confirm if AWS later)
- Metering approach: meter SKU or usage event (TBD by Sara)
- Entitlement mapping doc (sample CSV or API)
- Legal: co-sell addendum template (we require signed addendum for co-sell privileges)
- Tech evidence: sample deployment diagram, latency SLOs, support contacts

Gaps from Nova's metering sheet (attached metering_spec_v2.xlsx):
- Event name mismatch: nova_usage_seconds vs "runtime_seconds" we standardize on — Karthik to propose canonical event names.
- No sample payloads for trial/credit events.
- No customer id mapping (we need the ID field they expect).

Attachments: metering_spec_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Planned next steps: 
- Monday 07/16: intake call (Marissa schedule)
- Within 72 hours after call: Karthik to deliver a gap list and a small mapping doc we can send to Nova
- Legal: I will prep a co-sell addendum draft and send to Ben for review — goal to have DocuSign by EOW next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-partners@google.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Chen <sara@novaai.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@azuremarket.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ISV listing + co-sell / metering sync — next steps (DocuSign + onboarding)

Hi Ben / Marissa / Sara —

Thanks for the thread. GCP team here — confirming we can onboard Nova AI provided the metering schema matches our ingestion windows and the co-sell addendum is signed. Marissa, attaching our marketplace partner intake checklist (we've reviewed your items and added a few GCP-specific telemetry fields).

Key items from GCP: 
- Metering window: daily UTC batch ingestion (we need daily aggregated events + raw event samples during validation).
- Required fields: customer_email OR partner_customer_id, sku_id, usage_quantity, usage_unit, timestamp_utc.
- DOCS: sandbox meter endpoint available after partner registration.

Marissa — we saw metering_spec_v2.xlsx and are fine with Karthik's canonical events once mapped. Please send the co-sell addendum into DocuSign using this powerform link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?tf=CoSellAddendum123. Once signed, we'll provision sandbox access.

Attachments: DocuSign - CoSell Addendum.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
GCP Marketplace Ops Team
gcp-partners@google.com
